headline: Shift Data Center Grid Costs to Users
short_summary: This bill aims to shift electricity infrastructure costs from residential ratepayers to large energy users, primarily data centers, to reduce household utility bills.
supporters: Senator Louise Lucas, Delegate Destiny LeVere Bolling, Dominion Energy (initially), consumer advocates
opponents: Major tech firms, critics of Governor's amendments
news_headline: Governor Amends Data Center Cost-Shifting Bills
news_summary: Governor Spanberger suggested alterations to HB 1393, a bill designed to shift more electricity costs onto data centers to save residential customers money and expand a power line burial program. Critics argue her amendments weaken the original intent of the legislation.

headline: Mandate Data Center Water Use Reporting
short_summary: This legislation requires local water authorities to publicly report the water consumption of data centers to increase transparency.
supporters: Senator Kannan Srinivasan, Potomac Conservancy, environmental and water advocates
news_headline: New Virginia Law Requires Data Center Water Reporting
news_summary: A new Virginia law mandates local water authorities to report data center water usage, making the information publicly available on the Department of Environmental Quality's website. Senator Kannan Srinivasan championed the bill to increase transparency regarding the industry's water consumption.

headline: Establish Data Center Siting and Noise Rules
short_summary: This bill mandates site assessments for new high energy use facilities, including data centers, to evaluate noise impacts and other environmental factors.
supporters: Delegate Joshua Thomas, Delegate Sam Rasoul, local communities
news_headline: Virginia Law Requires Data Center Siting Assessments
news_summary: HB 153, now law, requires site assessments for new high energy use facilities, including data centers, to examine sound profiles near homes and schools. Localities can also require assessments on impacts to water, agriculture, parks, and historic sites.
